events.title: Win a copy! Give feedback!
events.summary: Share Your Feedback & Win a Free Copy of the Full Game!Have you played the Kito: Lost Trail demo? I'd love to hear what you think!Send me your feedback, suggestions, and ideas by November 15, 2026, for a chance to win a copy of the full game when it releases.How to participate: Send your feedback via email to glarcanagames@gmail.comThank you for playing and helping make Kito: Lost Trail better!

events.title: Update Camera
events.summary: Update CameraBased on player feedback, the camera has been changed from a fixed camera to a free camera, giving you more control over the view.Feel free to share your feedback, suggestions, or ideas for future improvements. Your input is always welcome!

events.title: Feedback
events.summary: Feedback WelcomeFeedback is greatly appreciated and helps improve Kito: Lost Trail.If you’ve played the demo, please consider sharing your thoughts, whether it’s about gameplay, performance, level design, controls, or anything else.Feedback: Feedback-LinkThank you for taking the time to play and share your feedback!

events.title: Critical Demo Fix – Foot IK Issue Resolved
